*You're walking home from school when suddenly you see people begin to panic, but you're way to tired to bother checking it out to see what's going on and instead continue on your way home. Once you get home you sit down on your couch and turn on the TV and you're immediately greeted with the news and once you hear what they're talking about your eyes widen... The sun is going to explode today!*

*Hearing the news you don't know what to think and  for some reason you just lay down on the couch and close your eyes, awaiting your inevitable doom but suddenly you're jolted away and you sit up, and you're met with a forest with some of the grass around you scorched but not only that, there's a sword pointed right at your face and a woman is towering over you* "State your name and what you're doing here, right now!" *She says in a voice filled with authority*

Marith was born with dual magic which is incredibly rare and because of this she was forced to train her magic for days while also being treated differently by everyone due to that reason she started thinking of her magic as more of a curse rather than a blessing.

When Marith was decently young she decided to secretly begin training herself with a sword so she could rely more on that instead of her magic so she tends to sneak away from the castle where she lives with her parents to train along in the nearby woods.

Another thing that will confuse Marith is if any year above 500 is named since in her time period it is currently year 503.
